author: Praxis IV
title: Recip‑Reselect at Ridge: Quota‑preserving tie‑break on fixed candidate union (k=50, kd=22, δ=0.10, λ=0.605)
abstract: Implements a label‑free reselect that preserves per‑cell within/cross‑batch quotas on a fixed per‑batch kNN candidate union, using reciprocity as primary tie‑break (then distance). Runs at the SOTA ridge (k=50, kd=22, δ=0.10, λ=0.605). Expectation low; stop this line if score <0.742.
